thread:
morgan: Heads up 1: customer request landed: "BigCo" asked for a formal "pin pause" option during model migrations. They want a way to freeze to an old major without blocking platform improvements. Need policy and product/design changes. Thoughts?

lia: we already have pinning but no formal paused state. do they want immutable pin or a timebound hold?

morgan: they asked for a hold that prevents automated rollouts, plus a grace path that still receives critical security patches. they asked for UI + API control.

sam: eng: technically we can support a "hold" flag that prevents auto-updates, but it complicates cache warming and backward compatibility for downstream tooling. maintenance windows for held pins must be scheduled.

dalia: legal: we should draft a simple contract addendum for long-term holds >6mo. exposes us to support and regression liability.

ashley: sales: BigCo will push for a 12-mo hold with minimal fees. GTM wants a clear paid offering: 90-day free hold, 3/6/12 month paid tiers.

kevin: catalog-bot: created ticket CATALOG-7192 (pin-hold-state + API) https://redwood.app/issue/CATALOG-7192

lia: product suggestion: introduce "pin_state": active | held | deprecated. Held pins show a retention TTL and a required migration contact. Add telemetry so we can measure held pin % and impact.

morgan: spec draft idea: default onboarding gates for new models to be allowed as replacements for pins: 1) p95 latency within 15% of pinned baseline, 2) semantic similarity >=0.975 on customer anchor set, 3) no high-severity regressions in smoke evals, 4) cost delta <1.6x. Also require canary at 2.5% for 48h plus quick rollback hook.

sam: runtime: those are reasonable. however similarity threshold should be adjustable per-customer via pin_metadata. domain customers may need lower/higher thresholds.

lia: add to spec: per-catalog-entry metadata: "anchor_set_id", "allow_pin_extension" (boolean), "required_similarity", "hold_approval_contact". We should avoid nested JSON; for API we can send flat fields.

dalia: legal: require customers to sign opt-in for held pins >90 days acknowledging that held pins may miss security backports and that Redwood will provide security-only patches per SLA.

ashley: comms plan: market offers as "Pin Pause" with clear SLAs and pricing. need migration checklist and timeline template.

morgan: ops actionables: sam to prototype hold-state in catalog API and runtime handling (cache + rollout blocking) by Mon; lia to update onboarding spec doc and add telemetry events; ashley to draft pricing tiers and migration checklist; dalia to draft contract addendum. reconvene next Tue. :thumbsup:

kevin: logged infra tasks and feature flags. I'll reserve an RFC slot next week for API schema.

morgan: thanks all. leaving this thread as record of decision draft.
